# ViraStack Address

> Headless Turkish address hook for React: chained province (il), district (ilçe) and neighbourhood (mahalle) selects, derived postal codes, server validation and the PTT dataset. npm: `@virastack/address` (1.0.x). Zero runtime dependencies.

Install: `npm install @virastack/address`. Peer: `react` (≥ 18.2), optional for the `/server` and `/data` entries. One hook, `useViraAddress()`, returns prop getters for any select (`native`, `headless`, `shadcn`, `antd`) and a `value` with the postal code. The postal code also works the other way: `getPostalCodeInputProps()` or `setPostalCode()` fills province and district from a typed code, and the neighbourhood when the code has only one. `formatAddress()` puts an address on one line ("Alandüzü Mah. Adapazarı/Sakarya"). Data: 81 provinces, 973 districts, 72,466 neighbourhoods; a province's neighbourhoods load when it is picked. Not a component: no markup, no styles.

Entry points: `@virastack/address` (hook), `@virastack/address/server` (`resolveAddress`, `resolvePostalCode`, no React, safe in Server Actions), `@virastack/address/data` (dataset, no React).

React Hook Form: pass `form` (`useForm()` or `useFormContext()`) and every pick is written to `province`, `district`, `neighbourhood` and `postalCode` (rename with `names`). It follows `form.reset(data)`, the `values` option and `setValue()` on a level (React Hook Form 7.55+ `subscribe`), and the form stays pristine.

Full reference for agents: [Address llms-full.txt](https://virastack.com/address/llms-full.txt).

## Docs

- [Introduction](https://virastack.com/address/docs): Install, comparison, entry points, requirements
- [useViraAddress()](https://virastack.com/address/docs/use-vira-address): `value`, options, return value, custom `source`
- [React Hook Form](https://virastack.com/address/docs/react-hook-form): `form`, `names`, FormProvider, edit forms, Zod
- [From a postal code](https://virastack.com/address/docs/postal-code): `getPostalCodeInputProps`, `setPostalCode`, `postalCodeStatus`
- [UI libraries](https://virastack.com/address/docs/ui-libraries): Native select, shadcn, Ant Design, headless
- [Server validation](https://virastack.com/address/docs/server): `resolveAddress`, `resolvePostalCode`, issues, derived postal code
- [Dataset](https://virastack.com/address/docs/data): PTT source, counts, updates, usage without React
- [Helpers](https://virastack.com/address/docs/helpers): `formatName`, `toSearchKey`, `compareNames`, `formatAddress`
- [Types](https://virastack.com/address/docs/types): All exported types
